questions.question: Cloud computing nima va uchta asosiy servis modeli (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) qanday?
questions.explanation: Cloud computing — compute, storage, ilova va boshqa IT resurslarni internet orqali talab bo'yicha, pay-as-you-go narx bilan yetkazish.

questions.question: Shared Responsibility Model IaaS, PaaS va Serverless'da qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Xavfsizlik provayder va mijoz o'rtasida bo'lingan:

questions.question: Region, Availability Zone (AZ), Local Zone va Edge Location farqi.
questions.explanation: Region: alohida geografik hudud (us-east-1), bir nechta izolyatsiyalangan AZ'dan iborat.

questions.question: VPC / VNet nima?
questions.explanation: Akkauntingizga ajratilgan mantiqan izolyatsiyalangan virtual tarmoq: IP diapazoni, subnet, route table, gateway va xavfsizlik sozlamalari ustidan to'liq nazorat.

questions.question: Public subnet va private subnet farqi.
questions.explanation: Public: route table'da default route (0.0.0.0/0) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Internet Gateway ga. Instance'larda public IP bo'lishi va internet bilan bevosita aloqa mumkin.

questions.question: Internet Gateway (IGW) nima?
questions.explanation: Gorizontal scale qilinadigan, redundant, yuqori mavjud VPC komponenti — public subnet resurslari va internet o'rtasida bandwidth cheklovisiz aloqa.

questions.question: NAT Gateway va NAT Instance farqi.
questions.explanation: NAT Gateway: to'liq boshqariladigan AWS servisi, 100 Gbps gacha, avtomatik scale, AZ ichida HA, administrativ ish yo'q (lekin GB uchun to'lov qimmat).

questions.question: Security Group va Network ACL (NACL) farqi.
questions.explanation: SG: instance/ENI darajasida stateful firewall. Faqat Allow qoidalari; hammasi birga baholanadi; javob trafigi avtomatik ruxsat.

questions.question: VPC peering nima va cheklovlari?
questions.explanation: Ikki VPC o'rtasida private backbone orqali to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ulanish.

questions.question: AWS Transit Gateway (TGW) nima?
questions.explanation: Yuzlab VPC, Direct Connect va VPN'larni bitta boshqariladigan gateway orqali bog'laydigan hub-and-spoke router — tranzitiv routing va markaziy inspeksiya.

questions.question: AWS PrivateLink nima?
questions.explanation: VPC, AWS servislari va third-party SaaS o'rtasida sizning subnet'ingizdagi private IP'li ENI orqali ulanish — trafik public internetga umuman chiqmaydi.

questions.question: Gateway VPC Endpoint nima?
questions.explanation: VPC subnet'larini S3 va DynamoDB ga NAT yoki public IP'siz AWS ichki tarmog'i orqali ulaydigan bepul route table yozuvi.

questions.question: ALB, NLB va GWLB farqi.
questions.explanation: ALB (L7): HTTP/HTTPS/gRPC'ni host, path, query, method bo'yicha yo'naltiradi; TLS termination, redirect.

questions.question: EBS, S3 va EFS farqi.
questions.explanation: EBS: bitta EC2'ga ulanadigan block storage (ext4, XFS) — past latency, yuqori IOPS.

questions.question: EBS volume turlari (gp3, io2 Block Express, st1, sc1) qanday?
questions.explanation: gp3: umumiy SSD, bazaviy 3000 IOPS va 125 MB/s; IOPS va throughput hajmdan mustaqil sozlanadi.

questions.question: EC2 IMDSv2 nima?
questions.explanation: Metadata servisining xavfsiz versiyasi: avval PUT so'rovi bilan X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds header orqali session token olinadi — SSRF orqali credential o'g'irlashni keskin qiyinlashtiradi. Hop limit = 1 cont...

questions.question: AWS Auto Scaling va ASG nima?
questions.explanation: Compute yuklamasini kuzatib, ishlab turgan EC2 sonini dinamik o'zgartiradigan servis — barqaror unumdorlik eng past narxda.

questions.question: Auto Scaling policy turlari (Target Tracking, Step, Scheduled, Predictive) qanday?
questions.explanation: Target Tracking: metrikani berilgan qiymatda ushlaydi (o'rtacha CPU 65%, target'ga 1000 request).

questions.question: Spot instance nima va Spot Fleet qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Ishlatilmayotgan sig'im On-Demand'dan 90% gacha arzon, lekin 2 daqiqalik ogohlantirish bilan qaytarib olinishi mumkin. Spot Fleet turli instance turlari va AZ'lar bo'yicha Spot va On-Demand aralashmasini boshqarib, ta...

questions.question: Savings Plans va Reserved Instances farqi.
questions.explanation: Compute Savings Plans: 1 yoki 3 yillik soatlik sarf majburiyati evaziga (72% gacha) chegirma; EC2, Lambda, Fargate bo'yicha instance oilasi, region, OS'dan qat'i nazar avtomatik qo'llanadi.

questions.question: AWS ECS nima?
questions.explanation: AWS'ning to'liq boshqariladigan container orkestratsiyasi: IAM, VPC, CloudWatch bilan nativ, Kubernetes murakkabligisiz.

questions.question: AWS Fargate nima?
questions.explanation: Container'lar uchun serverless compute (ECS va EKS): node'larni AWS boshqaradi, mijoz faqat so'ralgan vCPU va xotira uchun to'laydi.

questions.question: AWS EKS nima?
questions.explanation: Sertifikatlangan boshqariladigan Kubernetes: control plane'ni 3 AZ bo'ylab provision, upgrade, patch va HA qiladi.

questions.question: AWS Lambda va uning execution modeli qanday?
questions.explanation: Trigger'larga (S3 upload, API Gateway, SQS) javoban kodni Firecracker microVM'larida bajaradigan serverless event-driven compute; millisekund bo'yicha to'lov.

questions.question: Lambda cold start nima va qanday kamaytiriladi?
questions.explanation: Yangi execution environment yaratish, kodni yuklash va runtime'ni init qilish kechikishi. Provisioned Concurrency (oldindan isitilgan) yoki SnapStart (microVM snapshot'idan tiklash) bilan kamaytiriladi; init kodini ye...

questions.question: Amazon Aurora nima?
questions.explanation: PostgreSQL/MySQL bilan mos cloud-native relational DB: compute storage'dan ajratilgan, storage 3 AZ bo'ylab 6 nusxada, quorum yozish (4/6) va o'qish (3/6).

questions.question: Aurora Serverless v2 nima?
questions.explanation: Aurora'ning compute sig'imini (ACU) soniyaning bir qismida, faol ulanishlarni uzmasdan yuqoriga-pastga avtomatik scale qiladigan konfiguratsiyasi.

questions.question: Amazon DynamoDB nima?
questions.explanation: To'liq boshqariladigan serverless NoSQL key-value/document DB: istalgan scale'da bir xonali ms latency, multi-AZ replikatsiya, uzluksiz backup, Global Tables.

questions.question: DynamoDB single-table design nima?
questions.explanation: Barcha entity va munosabatlarni bitta jadvalda composite PK/SK va GSI'lar bilan modellash — murakkab bog'liq ma'lumotni bitta Query bilan olish. Access pattern'lar oldindan aniq bo'lishi shart.

questions.question: Route 53 nima va routing policy'lari qanday?
questions.explanation: Yuqori mavjud authoritative DNS servisi:

questions.question: Amazon CloudFront nima?
questions.explanation: Global CDN: statik/dinamik kontent, video va API'ni edge location'lar orqali past latency bilan yetkazadi.

questions.question: AWS Global Accelerator nima?
questions.explanation: Statik Anycast IP beradigan L4 servis: trafikni eng yaqin edge PoP'da qabul qilib, AWS private global backbone orqali ALB/EC2'ga olib boradi (DNS cache muammosisiz tez failover).

questions.question: AWS Direct Connect (DX) nima?
questions.explanation: On-prem data center'ni AWS tarmog'iga public internetni chetlab ulaydigan maxsus fizik optik ulanish — barqaror bandwidth va past latency (default shifrlanmagan).

questions.question: AWS Site-to-Site VPN nima?
questions.explanation: On-prem gateway (Customer Gateway) ni AWS VGW yoki Transit Gateway bilan public internet orqali shifrlangan IPsec tunnel bilan ulash.

questions.question: AWS IAM nima?
questions.explanation: AWS servislari bo'ylab foydalanuvchi, guruh va workload'lar uchun autentifikatsiya va ruxsatlarni markaziy boshqaradigan servis.

questions.question: IAM policy nima va asosiy JSON elementlari?
questions.explanation: Avtorizatsiyani belgilovchi JSON:

questions.question: IAM policy evaluation logikasi qanday?
questions.explanation: Aniq (explicit) Deny hammasidan ustun.

questions.question: IAM Role va IAM User farqi.
questions.explanation: User: uzoq muddatli statik credential (parol, access key). Zamonaviy standart: IAM user'lardan qoching, SSO ishlating.

questions.question: AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO) nima?
questions.explanation: Korporativ IdP (Okta, Entra ID, Google) bilan ulanib, ko'p akkauntli AWS Organization bo'ylab yagona SSO beruvchi markaziy identity servisi.

questions.question: AWS Service Control Policy (SCP) nima?
questions.explanation: Organization ichidagi akkauntlar uchun maksimal ruxsat chegarasini belgilovchi siyosat. SCP taqiqlasa, member akkauntning root user'i ham bajara olmaydi (SCP o'zi ruxsat bermaydi, faqat cheklaydi).

questions.question: AWS CloudTrail nima?
questions.explanation: Akkauntdagi har bir API chaqiruvni (kim, qaysi API, qachon, qaysi IP'dan, qanday parametr bilan) compliance va audit uchun yozadigan servis.

questions.question: Amazon CloudWatch nima?
questions.explanation: Metrika yig'ish, log'larni jamlash (CloudWatch Logs) va alarm chegaralarini baholash (Alarms) servisi.

questions.question: SSM Session Manager nima?
questions.explanation: Agent orqali EC2'ga 22-port ochmasdan, bastion'siz va public IP'siz xavfsiz shell kirish; sessiyalar IAM bilan boshqariladi va log qilinadi.

questions.question: AWS KMS nima?
questions.explanation: Kriptografik kalitlarni yaratish, boshqarish va rotatsiya qilish servisi (Customer Managed Keys); envelope encryption orqali AWS storage va ilovalarda ishlatiladi.

questions.question: Secrets Manager va Parameter Store farqi.
questions.explanation: Secrets Manager: avtomatik rotation (Lambda bilan), cross-account kirish, KMS shifrlash; har secret uchun to'lov.

questions.question: AWS WAF nima?
questions.explanation: CloudFront, ALB, API Gateway, AppSync'da ishlaydigan L7 firewall — OWASP Top 10 hujumlari (SQLi, XSS) va rate flood'ni bloklaydi.

questions.question: Shield Standard va Shield Advanced farqi.
questions.explanation: Standard (bepul): L3/L4 DDoS (SYN flood, UDP reflection) dan avtomatik himoya.

questions.question: Amazon GuardDuty nima?
questions.explanation: CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, DNS va EKS audit log'larini ML bilan tahlil qilib, buzilgan instance va kripto-mayning kabi tahdidlarni aniqlaydigan servis.

questions.question: AWS Security Hub nima?
questions.explanation: GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie, IAM Access Analyzer topilmalarini CIS va PCI-DSS standartlariga nisbatan jamlaydigan markaziy security posture servisi.

questions.question: Amazon Inspector nima?
questions.explanation: EC2, ECR image va Lambda'larni dasturiy zaifliklar va tarmoqqa ochiqlik bo'yicha avtomatik skanerlovchi servis.

questions.question: S3 storage class'lari qanday?
questions.explanation: Standard: tez-tez ishlatiladigan ma'lumot uchun.

questions.question: S3 versioning va MFA Delete nima?
questions.explanation: Versioning: obyektning tarixiy nusxalarini saqlaydi — tasodifiy ustidan yozish/o'chirishdan himoya.

questions.question: S3 Object Lock va WORM nima?
questions.explanation: Write-Once-Read-Many: belgilangan retention davrida obyektni hech kim (compliance rejimida root ham) o'chira yoki ustidan yoza olmaydi — ransomware va compliance uchun.

questions.question: S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) nima?
questions.explanation: Yangi yuklangan obyektlarni boshqa region'dagi bucket'ga asinxron avtomatik nusxalash — DR va lokal tez kirish uchun (versioning yoqilgan bo'lishi shart).

questions.question: S3 event notification nima?
questions.explanation: Obyekt o'zgarganda (s3:ObjectCreated:, s3:ObjectRemoved:) SQS, SNS, EventBridge yoki Lambda'ga avtomatik hodisa yuborish.

questions.question: Amazon EventBridge nima?
questions.explanation: AWS servislari, custom servislar va SaaS hamkorlardan event qabul qilib, deklarativ JSON filter qoidalari bilan target'larga yo'naltiradigan serverless event bus.

questions.question: SQS Standard va FIFO farqi.
questions.explanation: Standard: cheksiz throughput, at-least-once (ba'zan dublikat), tartib best-effort.

questions.question: Amazon SNS nima?
questions.explanation: Minglab subscriber'larga (Lambda, SQS, HTTP, SMS, email) xabar yetkazadigan boshqariladigan pub/sub servis; SNS+SQS fan-out pattern'i keng tarqalgan.

questions.question: AWS Step Functions nima?
questions.explanation: Deklarativ JSON state machine bilan mikroservis, Lambda va inson tasdiqlarini muvofiqlashtiradigan vizual serverless workflow orkestratori.

questions.question: CloudFormation va Terraform farqi.
questions.explanation: CloudFormation — AWS'ning o'z deklarativ IaC engine'i, state'ni AWS boshqaradi; Terraform — ochiq (BSL)/OpenTofu, multi-cloud, yuzlab provayder, state'ni o'zingiz boshqarasiz.
